name: Custody and Key Compromise
definition: Control of an agent's identity, assets, or authority is lost or captured through key or custody failure.
trigger_conditions: An agent holds signing authority without threshold or rotation
Key material is reachable by the same process that uses it
No recovery path distinguishes loss from theft
citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F028 Custody and Key Compromise. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F028
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
